en.t: Having said that, we went to sleep.

units.source_text: 第二天，我们又恢复了行商般的心态，淌着汗水，呼哧呼哧地走起来。

en.t: The next day, we returned to the mindset of peddlers, sweating and panting as we set out walking again.

units.source_text: 一路上，我不时想起那晚的事情，

en.t: Along the way, I kept thinking back to what had happened that night,

units.source_text: 心中后悔不迭，对我来说这么千载难逢的机会，为什么轻易地放过去了呢？

en.t: and I was filled with regret: why had I so easily let slip such a once-in-a-lifetime chance?

units.source_text: 应该直截了当地对他说个清楚，何必用‘人情味’这样抽象的词绕弯子呢。

en.t: I should have spoken plainly and told him everything, instead of circling around with an abstract word like “human feeling.”

units.source_text: 说实在的，我挖掘出这样的字眼，也是基于我对小姐的感情，

en.t: To tell the truth, I had dug up that kind of expression because of my own feelings for the young lady,

units.source_text: 所以对我来说，与其对他灌输那些筛除了事实的抽象理论，

en.t: so for me, rather than pouring into him abstract theories stripped of the facts,

units.source_text: 还不如把事情的本来面目摆在他面前对我更有利。

en.t: it would have been more to my advantage to lay the matter itself before him just as it was.

units.source_text: 在此，我可以坦白地告诉你，我之所以没能这样做，

en.t: Here I can tell you frankly that the reason I could not do so

units.source_text: 是由于以学问交往为基础的我们两人的友情带有一种与生俱来的惰性，

en.t: was that the friendship between us, founded on scholarly association, had a kind of innate inertia,

units.source_text: 而我恰恰缺乏突破它的勇气。

en.t: and I lacked precisely the courage to break through it.

units.source_text: 说是太清高也好，虚荣心作怪也罢，总之是一回事。

en.t: Whether you call it excessive refinement or the work of vanity, it comes to the same thing.

units.source_text: 但我说的这种清高和虚荣心，跟一般意义上的略有不同，

en.t: But the refinement and vanity I mean are somewhat different from the usual sense of those words,

units.source_text: 这一点只要你能明白，我就满足了。

en.t: and I will be satisfied if only you can understand that point.
